name: Critical Effects (DH2): Explosive - Leg
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-14 (p. 237). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Knocked back 1 metre. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or knocked Prone.
Knocked Prone. No Movement action except Half Move for [[1d5]] rounds.
Flung [[1d5]] metres in a random direction (Scatter Diagram). A Full Action to regain his feet, and Movement halved (rounding up) for [[1d10]] rounds.
Difficult (-10) Toughness test or suffer [[1d5]] levels of Fatigue. Agility permanently reduced by [[1d5]].
[[1d10]] levels of Fatigue. The leg is Useless until medical attention. Challenging (+0) Toughness test; on a failure he gains the Lost Foot condition.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness test or die from shock. On a success: [[1d10]] levels of Fatigue, Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and Blood Loss. Gains the Lost Leg condition.
The target dies. Everyone within 2 metres takes a single hit of [[1d10+2]] Impact damage to a random location.

As result 9. In addition, carried ammunition detonates: everyone within [[1d10]] metres takes a single hit of [[1d10+5]] Impact damage to a random location, and any carried grenades or missiles detonate immediately.
